# Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.1-rc.6

Requires HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.10 or later. Development target: DL322 USA 260507 (2022 Kia K5 EX). No new Android Auto development or validation.

## Session diagnostics and USB export
- Replace shell session-file copying with a dedicated Java exporter service; remove unsupported toolbox cmp -s calls.
- Verify each completed recording by length and SHA-256, publish per-file completion manifests, preserve conflicting destination files, and retry partial exports.
- Check USB mount identity before writes and publication, isolate failures per file, and retain source recordings for retries.
- Keep optional native TccCarPlay capture in a separate bounded rotating spool; restart failed collectors and export only finalized native groups through Java.
- Isolate dropped-event counters per journal generation and retry interrupted recordings on subsequent session starts.
- Add deterministic journal, exporter, native readiness and mount-change regression coverage.

## CarPlay transport
- Serialize incoming iAP2 packet delivery through one queue drain without holding the queue lock during Binder calls.
- Revalidate delayed Bluetooth attachment requests before and after hotspot activation; guard outdated failures and queued detach requests.
- Prevent duplicate concurrent component-5 handover initialization.
- Retain existing Wi-Fi provisioning, native audio, identity and projection recipes.

## Settings consolidation
- Four exposed controls: wireless CarPlay, automatic opening, integrated TBT and extended session diagnostics.
- Shared identity always enabled; integrated TBT defaults off for standalone coexistence.
- Legacy firewall toggles no longer override the wireless master setting.

## Follow-up reliability fixes
- Isolate receive drain generations on teardown, reattachment and USB takeover; exercise blocked Binder calls using production receive methods.
- Detect same-device USB remounts using kernel mount IDs, with regression coverage.

## Audit hardening
- Revalidate incoming packet generations before admission and invalidate receive ownership on Binder replacement. Report aggregate delivery attempts, exceptions and Binder timings in teardown snapshots.
- Bound native collector restart backoff, escalate shutdown signals and account for actual retention deletion results. Detect unowned native logcat writers through supported /proc and readlink checks; suspend duplicate collection and readiness publication when detected.
- Protect journal workers against filesystem permission failures; bound lifecycle backlog to 32 tasks in addition to 256 events, reserve finalization capacity, and report skipped sessions.
- Guard USB mount identity during copy chunks; eliminate redundant destination hashing on the existing verified path. Retire recognized stale manifests as .complete.invalid without overwriting conflicting data.
- Revalidate Bluetooth attachment immediately before broadcasting; retain the verified hotspot startup sequence.
- Include journal regressions in the release workflow and verify the immutable RC10 checkout matches the SDK pin.

## Compatibility and limitations
- The former opt-in IPv4 TCP 40515 hotspot ingress rule (experimental Canadian Ioniq 6 260206 support) was deliberately removed. Saved aa_firewall settings cannot restore it; wireless AA on units relying on that rule is unverified. CarPlay network rules follow the wireless master; HMG-API cellular policy is unchanged.
- Saved integrated TBT=true survives the new false default. Explicitly switch it off when using Standalone TBT, apply and restart.
- Native writer detection is best effort; it cannot terminate an abandoned process or detect a writer before its output is open. File synchronization is not a guarantee of directory metadata persistence after abrupt power loss.
- Align manifest and immutable hook catalogue validation with the RC10 SDK already pinned by the repository.
- Keep integrated TBT disabled when using Standalone TBT.
- No CPUL changes, new Android Auto validation, or changes to parked-video restrictions.
- Native logs are raw and may contain private information. Persistent filesystem failures can retain interrupted recordings. In-flight Binder calls and callbacks without a session identity cannot be fully generation-isolated; host concurrency tests pass; vehicle validation remains outstanding.
- CI is required before signed publication; K5 runtime validation of this candidate remains pending.

## Final audit corrections
- Attempt guarded destination-directory synchronization after payload and manifest publication and stale manifest retirement; warn and preserve verified exports if unavailable. Actual Android 4.4 directory fsync and abrupt power loss remain unverified.
- Recheck foreign native writer ownership during active collection and before restart/readiness; stop only the owned collector. Invalidate queued Bluetooth attachments on USB takeover and iAP2 disconnect. Residual process ownership and Android broadcast races remain.
- Cross-project source audit against CPUL 823530b confirms matching shared identity API v2 and nonoverlapping CarPlay Core recipe regions. Native activation remains unverified.
- Latest runtime CI passed (45931183696). No signed release or vehicle test is claimed.
